status: PROPOSED by Worker B2 (OCS-MVP-QGATE-05) for Qualification freeze; not frozen, not an acceptance. Qualification owns the set, the oracle and every verdict. A change is a NEW versioned file (v2), never an edit of v1.
rulings: Architect A3/A4 (issue #215 comment 6537418060): empty NC4-03 placeholder eliminated; explicit versioned mutation set; deterministic source/predicate mutations are mandatory; host-dependent predicates are separate subcases (nc4_03_host_subcases.v1.json) that cannot alter this set's verdict.

target.input_note: Verdicts are a pure function of these bytes and the predicate in _kwflow.py: a different tree or interpreter is not this candidate (FAIL / BLOCKED), never PASS.

relation_to_supplementary_entries: The 183 `supplementary_nc4_03_predicate` battery entries (KW-001..KW-183 = every test of test_kwflow.py) remain, unchanged and still collected: they are the predicate's own self-tests (71 negative and 7 positive fixtures, baseline, pin records, 43 ingress mutants, 23 v5 evading mutants, tree and interpreter tests). This set does NOT re-implement or replace them. It selects, from the origin-rule mutants those tables already contain (provenance field on each mutation), a FROZEN mandatory subset expressed as data with the six required fields, runs it through its own runner on a copy of the pinned hub tree, and adds per-family negative controls that the supplementary tables lack. The 24 remaining MUTANTS (generic `**` forwarding, pinned-site un-pin, etc.) and the fixture-level negatives stay supplementary only.
verdict_rule: PASS iff every mutation's predicate holds (REJECTED as expected), every control's predicate holds (ACCEPTED), no control satisfies its family's rejection predicate, and the pinned input digests match. Anything else is FAIL; a non-3.13 interpreter or missing hub checkout is BLOCKED (never PASS). No host observation is read.

families.title: R1 origin rule: each of the six authority fields (claim_id, grant_id, grant_revision, effective_max_effects, authority_context_id, requested_permissions) and the envelope caller must come from the trusted producer, never from a client value

R1 origin rule, scoping and producer integrity: a producer or root name must be bound once, in the enclosing function, from the exact receiver of the real ingress (F1 scope, F2 producer shadowing, F3 envelope escape, N5 host binding, import/match/except rebinding)

v5 literal-only protected keywords: attempt_id, budget_id, expires_at, decision_input_commitment, decision_input_profile_version and now accept only constants (now only host.now) at every protected call
v5 authority-object mutation and dynamic construction: no attribute store, setattr or object.__setattr__ on a non-self authority object, no model_validate / __class__ proposal construction
v5 fixed-form keys and positional values: RuntimeProposal keys in the fixed update display and positional values into ExecutionOperation / ExecutionEnvelope are constants or trusted expressions only
Tree and pin integrity (fail closed): any byte change in a scanned file, a changed pinned site, a vanished required site, or any extra / missing / replaced entry in the recursive tree is rejected
